notes.title: Checkpoints
notes.notes:
[b]Checkpoints[/b] will be coming to the game very soon in our first update.

Players will have the choice of two game modes:
Lunaris (Original)
Lunaris (Checkpoints Enabled)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45005159/14edb20d21c8dcc47cfb8c173cec83dc1d2ef511.png[/img]

Players will still be required to complete the game in one sitting as the checkpoints do not save your progress upon exiting the game. We still want the game to be challenging, but at the same time we want players to enjoy the experience we have created.
